name: Round-leaved Sundew
desc: Round-leaved Sundew (Drosera rotundifolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Drosera rotundifolia, the round-leaved sundew, roundleaf sundew, or common sundew, is a species of carnivorous flowering plant that grows in bogs, marshes and fens.
